prose: The Wall Street Journal reports that companies are increasingly using AI benchmarking services that aggregate public job listings and other payroll data to identify under- and over-paid employees - an invisible way AI is shaping pay decisions. The article is paywalled, so this summary is based on the headline and lead captured by the feed.
highlights: Companies use AI benchmarking to aggregate job listings and payroll data
Goal: spot under- and over-paid employees
Paywalled - summary based on headline and lead
